decisions.reason: The hearty bread draws directly on the firm's core baking knowledge and fits its everyday range, so it can be kept and adjusted at low cost.
The sweet pastry builds on the firm's established confectionery craft, so its early results are easy to read and the recipe can be refined in-house, though such items rotate more often.
The crusty farmhouse bread sits squarely within the firm's heritage recipes and regional sourcing, so it fits well with the knowledge the firm already holds.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship that combines traditional craft with external recognition the firm can interpret and build on, making it a strong keeper.
The gold-awarded premium stollen builds on the firm's seasonal stollen expertise and has proven quality, so it remains a valuable seasonal product.
